obligations.iso-45001:ohs: ISO 45001: hazards identified and controls kept.
obligations.puwer:machinery-safety: PUWER 1998: work equipment safe, guarded and maintained; lock-out/tag-out honoured.
obligations.iso-9001:traceability: ISO 9001: a lot traceable to its inputs and its release decision.
obligations.riddor:reporting: RIDDOR 2013: reportable incidents notified within the time.
obligations.hse:incident-investigation: HSE guidance: an investigation on every incident — a person's.
obligations.coshh:substances: COSHH 2002: substance controls read before a job on them.
obligations.equality-act:fairness: Reused from the bank: outcomes compared by cohort — here shift and agency status.

glossary.work order: The root entity (the Kit says “visitor”): one job on one machine for one product.
glossary.lot: The quantity a work order produces, sampled against a specification, held or released.
glossary.lock-out: A machine isolated and tagged so it cannot run — never overridden by the assistant.
glossary.incident: A near miss, an injury or a release, with a severity — special category where it is a person's injury.
